== Summary ==
Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 24: the slip of [[Dreaded Imperial Starfleet (V) (Errata 4)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014), cropped at 300 dpi. It prints errata version PC-E4 (“Deploy on table. While you have more systems on table than opponent, your capital starships may deploy at -2 (to a maximum of -3) to battlegrounds. When you deploy an Imperial-class Star Destroyer, may deploy (for free) a [Death Star II] or [A New Hope] squadron there (no replacement necessary) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Not an official image file.''' Crop made 11 November 2026 for batch C2/C3 (swccg-guild/work#236). Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
